summary.text: Cassie Armstrong is a Democratic member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 19, serving since 2023. The legislature's profile lists Armstrong as Senate Minority Whip. Her profile name is Cassie Chambers Armstrong.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Cassie Chambers Armstrong was born on September 30, 1986, in Berea, Kentucky, and is an assistant professor of law at the University of Louisville Brandeis School of Law.
The profile lists a B.A. and an M.P.H. from Yale University, an M.Sc. from the London School of Economics, and a J.D. from Harvard Law School.
It also lists work as a Skadden Fellow providing legal services to survivors of domestic violence, research focused on rural access to justice, and past service on the Louisville Metro Council.
